description: One round in full: { round } with its mode, target and pot, its state in words (stateText), and its proof: the holder snapshot's slot, the ticket total, the Merkle root, the drand round and randomness, and the winning ticket (SHA-256 of the randomness, as a number, modulo the total). A prize the creator awarded has proof { awardedBy: "creator" }; a round not drawn yet has none.
name: get_round
title: Get one round with its proof
